articles.title: Italy’s Ustica enigma: Can French files solve mystery crash blamed on stray missile?
articles.description: France’s decision to share defence documents with the Italian judiciary has raised hopes of a breakthrough in investigations into the 1980 crash of a passenger jet near the island of Ustica, which a former Italian president claimed was mistakenly shot down by a French fighter jet. articles.title: Fresh protests over housing flare in Spain after lawmakers reject relief measures

articles.title: Flavio Bolsonaro: In the name of the father, sons, and holy ideology
articles.description: The first round of Brazil’s presidential election on Sunday pits two well-known names in the political ring: Lula vs. Bolsonaro. But it’s not former president Jair Bolsonaro facing off against the incumbent head of state – it’s his eldest son, Flavio Bolsonaro. He’s less charismatic than his father but just as ideologically radical as the family patriarch.

articles.title: La Corée du Nord a lancé un nouveau missile balistique, selon Séoul

articles.title: Ethiopia's Tigray rebels abandon regional capital Mekelle as government forces enter city
articles.description: Ethiopian federal forces have entered the capital of the northern Tigray region and seized its airport, witnesses said Saturday, reversing a takeover by rebels from the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) that prompted the suspension of commercial flights last month. The TPLF has been fighting against pro-government forces since September 23, raising fears of an all-out civil war similar to that of 2020-2022.

articles.title: 🔴 UAE investigators say Flydubai co-pilot was planning 'terrorist act'
articles.description: The Omani co-pilot accused of attacking the captain aboard a Flydubai flight to Israel on September 30 attempted to carry out a "terrorist" attack, the United Arab Emirates prosecutor general said ​Saturday. The alleged assailant, identified as Omani national Hamam al-Hammami, had been barred from flying in his country due to his radical ideological views, several media reported.

articles.title: Russia strikes another Kyiv bridge, deepening travel chaos in Ukraine's capital
articles.description: Kyiv's Northern Bridge across the Dnipro river was hit by a Russian air attack, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said Saturday, deepening travel chaos amid an escalation in strikes ​on ‌infrastructure in the Ukrainian capital. The latest attack comes a day after the city's Southern Bridge was hit by several strikes that officials said were "tearing Kyiv apart".

articles.title: Guerre en Ukraine: un nouveau grand pont de Kiev touché par une frappe russe

articles.title: North Korea launches ballistic missile as tensions with Seoul grow over border mine blasts
articles.description: North Korea launched a ballistic missile Saturday morning from the Wonsan area on its east coast into the Sea of Japan, according to South Korea's military. The launch comes amid renewed tensions between Pyongyang and Seoul, with the latter demanding an apology for a blast that wounded three South Korean soldiers inside the Demilitarized Zone last month.

articles.title: La FFF distribue des bons d'essence pour les clubs amateurs pour faire face à la montée des prix des carburants

Un savoir-faire naturel qui pourrait apporter des réponses aux défis hydriques de demain.
